title: Splitting a long function without changing behaviour

concepts.description: Moving a cohesive block into a named function shortens the caller and gives the condition a name without changing what the program does.
concepts.context: the idle-and-pending condition in cadence.ts moves into isIdleWithWork, leaving nextAction a flat list of cases

concepts.description: A refactor changes structure and not observable behaviour, which is what lets existing tests prove it safe.
concepts.context: nextAction in cadence.ts returns the same Action for every state and config as before the split

concepts.description: Handling the exit cases first, in a flat sequence of returns, keeps the main path readable.
concepts.context: the config.cadence === 'off' early return stays first in nextAction in cadence.ts
